title: Graph enrichments
keyFindings: Graph enrichments (entity resolution, relationship/property enrichment, denoising) supply the relationship context that vector similarity cannot, directly addressing the source talk's 'vectors don't capture relationship data' and 'similarity != relevance' theses.

Astrographer's fact/reference/embed graph (astrographer.md §4.2) is already a property-rich graph; the highest-value enrichment is entity resolution over `fact` nodes so the single-source-of-truth invariant (§4.2.3) is not fragmented across duplicate keys.

Zodiac's pre-graphing pipeline (zodiac.md §4.2) is the suite's graph-construction surface and the natural home for enrichment: entity resolution across crawled sources plus derived relationship/property edges make `graph`-mode queries (§4.3.2) complete.

Enrichment is LLM-heavy and ingestion-time, so D2 local-first is the deciding constraint: entity resolution and relationship enrichment can run on the suite's existing local LLMs, but the GraphRAG-style community-summarization pass is the heaviest and least D2-friendly and should be parked.

Enrichment is a clean D3 interconnection capability: Zodiac enriches its pre-graphs, Astrographer consumes them (edge #1) and enriches its fact graph, and Familiar/Solomon consume enriched graphs; it is not a D4 carve-out, so every enrichment feature must be exposed on both GUI and MCP.

Incanter's token-transition multigraph (incanter.md §4.4) is a co-occurrence structure, not a semantic entity graph, so semantic enrichment belongs in Astrographer/Zodiac, not Incanter (DISCARD for Incanter).
summary: Graph enrichments improve graph-aware RAG by resolving duplicate entities, adding relationship/property edges, and denoising the graph — supplying the relationship context vector similarity lacks. For the Auspicion Suite the highest-value, lowest-cost increments are entity resolution over Astrographer's `fact` nodes (astrographer.md §4.2.1) and entity resolution + relationship/property enrichment in Zodiac's pre-graphing pipeline (zodiac.md §4.2), both runnable on local LLMs (D2). The heavy GraphRAG-style community-summarization pass is parked, and semantic enrichment of Incanter's token graph is discarded.
